locked_rules: All 162 players remain addressable even when no sportsbook market is available.
Football projection distributions are generated before and independently of sportsbook prices.
Every two-sided price is de-vigged with the shared Step 13 proportional method before probability edge is measured.
Weekly prop probabilities use the exact selected-family CDF/PMF, including discrete pushes and compound reception PMFs.
Season prop probabilities reuse the existing season football projection center and uncertainty distribution; price never determines the projection center or sigma.
Market snapshots are evaluated independently so line movement can create, strengthen, weaken, flip, or eliminate a recommendation without rewriting the football projection.
Push probability is explicit; fair-market comparison uses conditional win probability and EV treats a push as zero return.
A PICK requires probability edge, EV, and model conditional win probability to all clear the locked minimums; otherwise PASS.
CLOSE snapshots are evaluation/CLV context only and never replace the price available at recommendation time.
No recommendation may place a wager, size a stake, or mutate fantasy, player, or game projections.
